description: Single freshness policy: how long a field may go without a successful check (checkDays) and how old its publication may be (dataDays) before it is reported. Read by report-asset-fields.mjs, collect_instrument_metadata.py and collect_scpi.py. Per-workflow run cadence stays in automation-workflows.json (maxAgeHours).

investor.13f.note: Contrôle quotidien des nouvelles déclarations ; la période 13F conserve sa date trimestrielle et son délai réglementaire de publication.

etf.default.note: Countries, sectors, holdings, AUM: issuers republish monthly.

etf.ter.note: Annual fee: may legitimately date from the last financial year.

etf.staticCharacteristic.note: Changes only through a prospectus amendment or a fund merger.

etf.performance.note: Calendar years: the last complete year is published in the following months.

scpi.quarterlyBulletin.note: Quarterly bulletins are published about a month after the quarter; a missing link is a wait until then.
